id.description: Unique identifier for each instance of the job.

startTime.description: Job execution start time in UTC format.

endTime.description: Job execution end time in UTC format.

lastUpdated.description: Last time the job's execution status was updated in UTC format.

statusMessage.description: Displays status for overall steps that are part of the job.

exitCode ExecutionStatus, optional).description: Final execution status for the job.

createdTime.description: Job creation time in UTC format.

timeElapsed.description: Time lapsed since the job execution started.

stepExecutionStatuses.description: Status of each step within a job.
